title: The Iron Man's Evolution: How Mikal Bridges Became the Blueprint for Championship Defense
description:
When the Knicks traded five first-round picks for Mikal Bridges in 2024, the basketball world questioned the price. Two years later, with a championship ring on his finger and a consecutive games streak that defines an era, Bridges has become the blueprint for how role players win titles. This is the story of the Iron Man's evolution.

From his heartbreaking Finals loss with Phoenix in 2021 to his championship triumph in New York in 2026, Bridges brought more than elite defense and durability. He brought Finals experience, Villanova chemistry, and a selfless mentality that became the foundation of a championship culture. As the Knicks prepare to defend their title, we examine how one player's consistency, professionalism, and willingness to sacrifice became the perfect complement to Jalen Brunson's heroics.
